subject: Scaffold capo project structure and dependencies
description:
Create the project skeleton per blueprint §"Project structure": `pyproject.toml`, top-level `capo/` package, basic structured logging setup, dev tool config (ruff/pytest).

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `pyproject.toml` declares project metadata and pinned core deps (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, DBOS, pydantic-settings, httpx, alembic, logfire).
- [ ] `capo/__init__.py` exists; `capo/main.py` exposes a runnable entry point that wires settings → store → listener (stub OK at this stage).
- [ ] `pytest`, `pytest-asyncio`, and `ruff` configured.
- [ ] `python -m capo` (or `uv run capo`) starts and exits cleanly on a stub config.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Missing `config.toml` produces a clear startup error rather than a stack trace.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: package importable; entry point resolves
• Smoke: `pytest` runs (zero tests OK at this stage)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Section 9.1 (Project scaffold)
